lines: A tiny magician performs a magic show on YOUR real table.
You are his volunteer: bare hands, no controllers.
Mixed reality for Meta Quest  ·  one continuous take of the real build, recorded in Meta XR Simulator

segments.do: Sit at your own table. A trapdoor opens in it and the magician rises.
segments.shows: Scene understanding finds the real table and anchors the stage on it.

segments.do: Don't touch. Just LOOK at one card.
segments.shows: Head gaze reads which card you chose. No cursor, no pointer.

segments.do: He lends you a coin. Pinch it up.
Carry it and set it down anywhere.
segments.shows: Pinch, carry, release: it lands on the real tabletop.

segments.do: The table opens under YOUR coin. Lean in and look down.
segments.shows: A lit theatre under your real table. He catches the coin far below.

segments.do: Open your palm. The coin appears in it.
segments.shows: Palm-up pose detection; the coin rides your hand.

segments.do: Open your palm. The coin appears in it.
segments.shows: Palm-up pose detection; the coin rides your hand.

segments.do: He teaches you a real trick: the Vanish.
segments.shows: You learn a move now. You will need it later.

segments.do: Close your fist... open it. Gone!
segments.shows: Fist and open-hand poses. "Remember that move."

segments.do: Something under the table steals the coin. The lights flicker.
segments.shows: The story turns: your real room dims around the show.

segments.do: Hold the trapdoor shut with both hands!
segments.shows: A two-handed hold, tracked while it bangs. It bursts open anyway.

segments.do: He comes back possessed. Your room goes dark.
segments.shows: Passthrough dimmed; his giant shadow is thrown on your real wall.

segments.do: Banish it with the move he taught you: fist, then open!
segments.shows: The lesson pays off. The stolen coin lands back in your hand.

segments.do: Cover the velvet case with a flat hand.
segments.shows: Palm-down cover gesture over a virtual prop.

segments.do: Lift it: empty! Your card rises from under the table.
segments.shows: The card you chose with your eyes, revealed.

segments.do: You saved the show. Take a bow.
segments.shows: Velvet curtains drop over your real wall.

segments.do: A nod of your head is the bow.
segments.shows: Head pose as input. The audience throws roses.

segments.do: Come back tomorrow: he knocks from the same spot.
segments.shows: A spatial anchor remembers your table. Three nights, three different shows.

lines: A magic show that needs your table, your hands and your room.
Scene understanding  ·  hand tracking  ·  head gaze  ·  passthrough  ·  spatial anchors
Seated  ·  about five minutes  ·  three nights of different tricks
